Amir Richardson (Le Havre) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Lamine Camara (Monaco).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Delay in match because of an injury Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Le Havre. Enzo Koffi replaces Yanis Zouaoui because of an injury.
Vincent Sasso (Le Havre) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Le Havre 0, Monaco 1.
Substitution, Monaco. Anis Soubeir replaces Mamadou Coulibaly.
